title: Crash retrieval traced back to Sarbacher 1950 and Mussolini 1933

tellings.quote:
There's going back to Robert Sarbacher
in 1950 and even before in 1933 with
Mussolini.

plain: Stories of governments recovering crashed alien craft are said to go back to the scientist Robert Sarbacher in 1950, and even earlier, to Italy under the dictator Benito Mussolini in 1933. A UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells Michels this in passing, without naming a source. If true, it would mean such recoveries began well before the famous 1947 events in Roswell, New Mexico.
